world_model_delta: Defense actions during conquest window: GUARD action doubles ownership_score delta for defender for that turn. Defender may request ally reinforcement: ally contributes score support at cost of 3 resource units. Defense is simulation-mechanical — no governance body arbitrates.
validator_question: Does ally reinforcement create a governance obligation for the reinforcing faction?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — mechanical reinforcement, no governance obligation
